context: A police officer briefs on compliance
purpose: Teach: 創っ/寄贈/自費/元本/学業/委ねる/備品/持ち歩い

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社が創ってきた防犯体制、業界の手本です。
lines.en: The crime-prevention system you've built here is a model for the industry.
lines.style: Even, measured acknowledgment. Light emphasis on 「体制」. Professional warmth—not distant. The tone of someone delivering a genuine compliment without overstatement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察図書館に、参考資料、寄贈しました。
lines.en: Yes. We donated reference materials to the police library.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift on 「はい」—eager to confirm and move forward. No hesitation. The tone of someone who takes pride in what was done.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 自費出版の調査本、共有していただきました。
lines.en: The self-published research you shared with us was particularly valuable.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Slight nod embedded in the voice. Acknowledging a specific contribution without making a show of gratitude. Professional recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元本減らさず、警備予算、確保します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll maintain the security budget without compromising the principal.
lines.style: Assured, confident. Clear articulation on the commitment. Not defensive—simply stating what will happen. The tone of someone who has already made this decision.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 学業期から、コンプライアンス教育、大事ですね。
lines.en: Compliance education from the academic level upward is crucial, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly reflective. Light emphasis on 「大事」. Not interrogating—more inviting agreement. The tone of someone who has seen the long-term effects.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。判断は、信頼できる者に委ねる体制です。
lines.en: Yes. Our system is to entrust these decisions to people we can rely on.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Steady pace. 「信頼できる者に」lands with understated firmness. Not boasting—simply describing how trust is built into the structure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察備品、共有時の管理、お願いします。
lines.en: Please keep careful management when shared police equipment is involved.
lines.style: Formal, clear directive. Even tone—not stern, but precise. 「管理」lands with slight weight. The tone of someone stating a non-negotiable requirement professionally.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。連携カード、社員が持ち歩いています。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff carry coordination cards with them at all times.
lines.style: Direct affirmation. Quick, efficient. Pride in the detail without elaboration. The tone of someone who has already anticipated this need.
